cards.title: after
cards.desc:
We saw an ant after lunch.
提示：after 意思是“在……以后”。

cards.title: again
cards.desc:
Please try again.
提示：again 意思是“再一次”。

cards.title: an
cards.desc:
I see an apple.
提示：an 意思是“一个”，放在元音音素开头的词前。

cards.title: any
cards.desc:
Do you have any crayons?
提示：any 意思是“任何的；一些”，常用于疑问句。

cards.title: as
cards.desc:
Do as I do.
提示：as 意思是“像……一样；按照”。

cards.title: ask
cards.desc:
Please ask your teacher.
提示：ask 意思是“问；请求”。

cards.title: by
cards.desc:
The book is by the bed.
提示：by 意思是“在……旁边”；字母 y 在这里读长音 /ī/。

cards.title: could
cards.desc:
Could you help me?
提示：could 意思是“可以；能”，表示礼貌请求。

cards.title: every
cards.desc:
Every child has a turn.
提示：every 意思是“每一个”。

cards.title: fly
cards.desc:
Birds fly in the sky.
提示：fly 意思是“飞”；字母 y 在词尾读长音 /ī/。

cards.title: from
cards.desc:
This gift is from Grandma.
提示：from 意思是“来自；从”。

cards.title: give
cards.desc:
Please give me the ball.
提示：give 意思是“给”；i 在这里不读常见的长音。

cards.title: going
cards.desc:
We are going home.
提示：going 意思是“正在去；将要去”。

cards.title: had
cards.desc:
He had a red kite.
提示：had 意思是“有过；拥有”。

cards.title: has
cards.desc:
She has a blue bag.
提示：has 意思是“有”；字母 s 在这里读 /z/。

cards.title: her
cards.desc:
Her cat is soft.
提示：her 意思是“她的”。

cards.title: him
cards.desc:
I gave him the book.
提示：him 意思是“他”，指一个男孩或男人。

cards.title: his
cards.desc:
His hat is green.
提示：his 意思是“他的”。

cards.title: how
cards.desc:
How are you today?
提示：how 意思是“怎样；如何”。

cards.title: just
cards.desc:
I just finished my work.
提示：just 意思是“刚刚；只是”。

cards.title: know
cards.desc:
I know the answer.
提示：know 意思是“知道”；k 不发音，读作 /nōʊ/。

cards.title: let
cards.desc:
Let us play outside.
提示：let 意思是“让”；常见短语 let us 意思是“让我们”。

cards.title: live
cards.desc:
Fish live in water.
提示：live 意思是“生活；居住”；这里读作 /lɪv/。

cards.title: may
cards.desc:
May I have some milk?
提示：may 意思是“可以”，用于礼貌请求。

cards.title: of
cards.desc:
I have a cup of tea.
提示：of 意思是“……的”；常读作轻音 /əv/。

cards.title: old
cards.desc:
The old dog is sleepy.
提示：old 意思是“老的；旧的”。

cards.title: once
cards.desc:
I once saw a rainbow.
提示：once 意思是“一次；曾经”。

cards.title: open
cards.desc:
Please open the door.
提示：open 意思是“打开”。

cards.title: over
cards.desc:
The bird flies over the tree.
提示：over 意思是“在……上方；越过”。

cards.title: put
cards.desc:
Put the book on the desk.
提示：put 意思是“放”。

cards.title: round
cards.desc:
We sat round the table.
提示：round 意思是“围绕；圆的”。

cards.title: some
cards.desc:
I have some crayons.
提示：some 意思是“一些”。

cards.title: stop
cards.desc:
Stop at the red light.
提示：stop 意思是“停止”。

cards.title: take
cards.desc:
Take your hat with you.
提示：take 意思是“拿；带走”。

cards.title: thank
cards.desc:
Thank you for the gift.
提示：thank 意思是“感谢”；thank you 是“谢谢你”。

cards.title: them
cards.desc:
I can see them.
提示：them 意思是“他们；它们”；th 发音要轻轻咬舌。

cards.title: then
cards.desc:
Then we went home.
提示：then 意思是“然后；那时”。

cards.title: think
cards.desc:
I think it is sunny.
提示：think 意思是“认为；想”；th 发音要轻轻咬舌。

cards.title: walk
cards.desc:
We walk to school.
提示：walk 意思是“走路”；字母 l 不发音。

cards.title: were
cards.desc:
They were happy.
提示：were 意思是“是；在”，用于 you、we、they 等。

cards.title: when
cards.desc:
When will you come?
提示：when 意思是“什么时候”。
